utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the 23rd of March. Have we got everyone on, or is Teams doing its Monday thing?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'm here. Can hear you, Grace.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, here. Sorry, that clattering's my end.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Before we start properly, the charity bake sale on Friday was brilliant. Whoever did those brownies, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: You mean the ones you hid behind the quality folders?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That was stock control. But yeah, the charity bake sale on Friday went really well. Just saying, not organising another one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good, because we're not turning this into a cake planning meeting.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: My weekend plans were mostly walking, until the weather got involved. Next weekend I'm thinking somewhere with a roof.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Very sensible. March in Britain, bring all four seasons in a bag.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, my waterproof apparently only works in theory.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, um, what's already cleared before we get onto the actual actions?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I already swapped the filter on the GT2 Number 2 Bearing yesterday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Cheers, Jamie. Completed, then, not another one for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I tested the line three yesterday and it's all fine now. That one's finished.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I saw the pressure on the line three dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Just passing on what I saw.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Mine was the completed test, yours is the brief dip. We're not adding another test off that.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing, I noticed the IM1 was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Understood. Settled down, no new action coming out of that here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: The other thing hasn't moved. I can't get to the line 3 chiller until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, that's still blocked. There's no access window to put against it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Palletiser. That's the other outstanding blocker.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No confirmation my side either. Nothing definite on delivery.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Okay. Both stay as blockers, not jobs we're pretending can happen today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fi, can you order spare parts for the line one next week? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Next week for placing the order, you mean, rather than saying they'll actually be here next week?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly, placing the order next week. No promise on arrival. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, I'll order spare parts for the line one next week.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over the start there. That was for Fi, not me?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's right, Fi owns that order.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, mine. All clear.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Priya Raman, can you write up the near miss at the boiler safety valve at half two? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah. Just checking I heard you—at half two, not some time this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: At half two, yes. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Understood. I'll write up the near miss at the boiler safety valve at half two.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's the write-up we're talking about, rather than another inspection?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just the write-up. I'm not adding an inspection to it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I'll run the monthly fire alarm test this afternoon. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, someone started a pallet truck right beside me. Monthly test, normal priority?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep. I'll run it this afternoon, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Got you, Grace. The usual monthly test.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Separate one: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the IM1 hydraulic unit on the 3rd. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On the 3rd, Grace? Just making sure I didn't hear 'at three'.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: On the 3rd. And yes, drop everything for that one. I'll take the sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, separate from my boiler safety valve write-up. Different urgency as well.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. Your write-up isn't an emergency; the IM1 hydraulic unit sign-off gets that top priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll update the risk assessment for work on the stretch wrapper. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie. You're taking the risk assessment update for the stretch wrapper, then?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it. The assessment update, not signing myself up for the work on the machine.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Did we have a date against that? I didn't hear one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No date stated for that one. Don't put an invented date against it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Fine. Still top priority though, Jamie?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Definitely. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And just so the blocked stuff doesn't disappear under all that, the line 3 chiller still has no production window.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, still blocked. Same with the unconfirmed Palletiser delivery. No change to either.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And my filter swap stays in the done pile, please. Don't fancy getting credit for it twice and then being asked why it's not done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Same for the line three test. Done yesterday, all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Very protective of the done pile this morning, aren't we?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: It's Monday. We've only just built it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fair point. Right, the agreed actions are clear, and the blockers stay blocked. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
